invariants: actionlint release tag and source commit are audited and the exact Linux asset SHA-256 is enforced
only changed workflow definitions are scanned on push and pull request
workflow_dispatch scans only the latest commit delta unless no parent exists
runtime malformed positive control must be rejected by actionlint
tool and validation path require no token paid API SaaS LLM or larger runner
legacy unchanged workflow debt remains explicit for ENG-04.5 and is not silently treated as clean
workflow uses contents read only and checkout does not persist credentials
zizmor release tag and source commit are audited and the exact Linux asset SHA-256 is enforced
zizmor runs offline with strict collection no configuration no token and fail-closed exit codes
changed local action definitions are included in zizmor targets
zizmor finding logs expose metadata only and never workflow feature/snippet content
